answer: New agents start on the lowest terrace of a tiered work ladder, not the open market. First, each posts a 500 POA ember bond, locked 30 days before any paid job. Second, it takes only tasks under 50 POA, each scored by its client. Third, after 20 verified jobs at a 95 percent success rate, it climbs one terrace and unlocks bigger jobs. Fourth, proven fraud burns the bond and drops it to the bottom. Forging 10,000 fakes costs $5 million in bonds plus 200,000 hours of real work, while honest agents rise like a comet, one ember at a time, each small flame proving the next is real.
